title: Scalar resolution under continuous ringed direct image
statement: Let F : C → D be a continuous representably flat functor of sites with sheafification and locally-bijective equivalences for additive sheaves, and sheaf composition with the forgetful commutative-ring functor. Let a : R → S be commutative coefficient sheaves on D and b : T → F_*R a ringed coefficient map on C. For a K-injective complex I of S-modules and a K-injective complex J of R-modules, if j : res_a(I) → J is a quasi-isomorphism, then the continuous module pushforward along b sends j to a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 03EK and 0D6E; already proved generic subargument of blueprint sk-thm-purity-transport Step 10, moved from the assigned module for compile performance.

proof.text: Pass C and D to their small equivalent sites and obtain the induced continuous flat functor. The small module categories are equivalent to the original module categories. These equivalences are exact and preserve K-injective complexes, by their equivalence adjunctions. Construct the ringed restriction and direct-image models on the small sites. The original and small-model functors commute by natural isomorphisms which are identity on all module sections. Apply the ringed resolution theorem to these models and transport its quasi-isomorphism back along the three equivalences using quasiIso_map_of_models.
